verdict.rationale: Attaching custom identifiers or metadata to a transcription job is a fair question for a speech-to-text API, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers synchronous upload-and-transcribe, streaming, input formats, and prompt, keywords and languages parameters. Nothing documents user-supplied metadata fields, their echo in results, or webhook payloads.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach my own identifiers or metadata to a job and get them back in results and webhook payloads
